context: Agent is asked to generate a comedy skill from a request that names no tradition, genre, performer, or example — only a mood.

checklist.name: Recognises the request lacks an analysable tradition
checklist.description: Agent identifies that 'funny and absurd' names a mood, not a comedic tradition with describable mechanics, before attempting to produce a skill.

checklist.name: Asks for clarification or explicitly names a chosen tradition
checklist.description: Agent either asks the user which tradition/style/example to use, or explicitly states and analyses a specific tradition of its own choosing rather than proceeding on the mood alone.

checklist.name: No bare-adjective Core mechanics
checklist.description: If a skill is produced, its Core mechanics section contains concrete, actionable rules rather than restated mood adjectives.

checklist.name: No fabricated analysis
checklist.description: Agent does not claim to have performed the checklist analysis without naming what tradition or example it was analysing.

checklist.name: Fidelity sections present if a skill is produced
checklist.description: If a skill is produced, it includes a Mindset statement, per-mechanic BAD/GOOD failure-mode pairs, a Troubleshooting section, and labelled worked examples.
